name: ZIF-8 two-solution mixing (solution 2 dispensed at pipette speed 5)
description: JSON equivalent of the CSV-runner sequence that produced the paper's ZIF-8 batches (src/flow/csv_runner/, historical lab version 4584333). Robot 1 dispenses 5 mL of solution 1 (Zn(NO3)2/PEG in DMF) at pipette speed 9 (nominal 0.45 s for 5 mL), then Robot 2 dispenses 5 mL of solution 2 (2-mIm/TEA in DMF) at pipette speed 5 (nominal 1.45 s for 5 mL, 3.4 mL/s). Both aspirate at speed 1. Each robot descends onto its source vial (0.1 mm), aspirates, rises, swings over the vial on the balance (+/-90 deg), lowers 120 mm into it, tares the balance at that lowered position, dispenses, reads the mass before rising and then returns home; go_home also undoes the rotation. The single capture_and_save at the very end is the only addition of this public example over the sequence that was run: the CSV runner took no photograph. Times are nominal values from the Picus 2 speed table (10.2 / 2.9 / 0.9 s per 10 mL at speeds 1 / 5 / 9); the speed step, not the time, is the setting under control. Geometry values are those of the lab's committed control sheet and must be re-measured for another fixture.
